additionalFix: Actual Linux startup defect reported by root: systemd reset RuntimeDirectory group between pre-start commands and ExecStart, making the worker socket inaccessible to gateway.
changes: Added a shared mutation gate for unfinished application and control transactions. Provider/catalog, HTTPS, trusted-control update, uninstall and release entrypoints fail before creating a new mutable transaction. Valid initial-release retries and explicit recovery remain available.

Existing completed operation receipts remain readable/replayable while a different transaction is pending. Read-only operation lookup no longer creates the receipt directory. Legacy installation-marker discovery is non-writing until the recovery gate allows mutation.
Initialization preflights instance paths, fixed unit names, known systemd search directories, drop-ins, sudo policy and loaded systemd state before creating identities or resumable configuration.

Resume, repair, trusted-control maintenance and uninstall validate complete managed unit/sudo definitions before managing them. Unrecognized overrides fail closed. Exact existing control-maintenance and HTTPS-recovery condition drop-ins remain recognized and preserved.

HTTPS rollback uses independent per-role persistent start conditions, restores the recorded enabled set, verifies it, and starts only previously active services. Gateway Wants=worker cannot restart a previously stopped worker. Uncertain recovery retains barriers and journal for repair.
PEM test headers are constructed dynamically while retaining the unchanged secret scanner rule.

Worker service uses its IPC group directly, with control and native groups supplementary; ineffective pre-start chgrp/chmod commands are removed. The exact old managed declaration is accepted only for ownership recognition and migrates after confirmed worker shutdown. systemd reload is repeated on a retry after publication/reload interruption.
Deployment documentation explains transaction gates, ownership checks, HTTPS recovery conditions and the IPC group migration.

checks: All new write entrypoints reach the shared pending gate; completed receipt replay does not re-execute mutation.
First-start and legacy installation retry semantics remain covered by 19 focused regressions.
Ownership checks precede stop/delete and preserve recognized control-update drop-ins; unrelated service contents remain untouched.
HTTPS barriers use different files from control maintenance and remain durable through failed recovery; successful repair clears only its own markers.
Worker UID, native UID/GID and sudo target permissions remain distinct; the service group change does not grant native IPC membership.
Exact legacy worker migration occurs only after confirmed shutdown; a failed reload is retried before start.
No implementation edit was made to deploy/native_launcher.py or tests/deploy/test_native_shutdown.py; root owns those changes.
